scope: Pure Python/C histogram wire parity plus Python-only repeated session/cleanup investigation. Native live and shared public lifetime remain open. No calibrated noise/coverage/TX claim.

commands.cancellation: Owned subprocess only: SIGTERM immediately after histogram_started, then wait for worker stop, full firmware reload and exit130. Separate dongles may run concurrently; never two owners of one radio.

qualification.offline: 1975 tests, native tests, ASan/UBSan including20,000 histogram malformed-input cases pass.
qualification.positive: Three sequential MT7925 one-shots per channel, each matching event and stopped timer banks, stable100ms repeated reads; MT7921 reset-separated250/500/1000ms host windows reset, accumulate and freeze. Normal RX/counter/thermal coexistence on channel6 both chips and channel36 MT7925. No session USB or queue-overflow errors.
qualification.negative: MT7921 channel36 normal RX stays absent as in prior controls, despite accumulating bin0 samples. No healthy5GHz RF qualification inferred.
qualification.cancellation: Both helpers cancel during first active acquisition and exit130 after full reload alive. Pending timer/host acquisition deliberately does not use masked-only restore; shared histogram history is not recoverable.
qualification.limitations: MT7921 stays bin0-only; MT7925 timer-view totals agree but distributions depend on channel/receiver state. Ordinary index1 differs. Neither raw threshold labels nor wall-time coverage are calibrated. Channel6 runs precede installed parser reuse; channel36/cancellation runs use promoted parser helpers.
